Author: mastajooh
Name: Play4ME
Punchline: Dodges BossmodReborn AOEs with vnavmesh and runs Wrath Combo's Auto-Rotation.
Description: Play4ME reads BossmodReborn's AOE telegraphs, moves your character to the nearest safe spot with vnavmesh, walks you back into range of your target, and turns on Wrath Combo's Auto-Rotation while enabled. Requires BossmodReborn and vnavmesh; Wrath Combo is optional. Toggle with /play4me.
